name: Pipelines - Actions
description: With pipeline Actions, you can now easily define a simple pipeline template that can be a single activity or multiple acitvities, without using the pipeline canvas. Simply tell Copilot what you want to achieve, answer a few configuration prompts, and then reuse your Actions in multiple pipelines or from other Fabric items like Data Activator or Functions.

result.descriptionEs: Las Actions permiten definir plantillas sencillas de pipeline (una o varias actividades) sin usar el lienzo: describes a Copilot lo que quieres, respondes a unas preguntas de configuración y reutilizas la Action en varios pipelines o desde otros elementos de Fabric como Data Activator o Functions.
